info.title: dotnet-tia
info.description: Test impact analysis for .NET: takes a git diff and runs only the tests that diff can affect.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: dotnet tia - test impact analysis for .NET. Takes a git diff and runs only the tests it can affect.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Print the tests a diff can affect. Runs nothing.

options.name: --base
options.description: Base revision to diff against. Defaults to the remote's default branch: origin/HEAD, else origin/main, else origin/master.

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository root. Defaults to the current directory. [default: <path>]

options.name: --solution
options.description: Solution or project to analyse. Discovered from the repository root when omitted; required when it holds several of one kind.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the full report as JSON on stdout. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: List every selected test and log workspace diagnostics. [default: False]

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Ignore and do not write .tia/graph-*.bin. [default: False]

options.name: --full
options.description: Skip selection and report a full run. [default: False]

options.name: --default-branch
options.description: Branch that always runs the whole suite. Selection is a pull-request optimisation.

options.name: --no-fallback-full-on-error
options.description: Fail instead of falling back to a full run when analysis throws. [default: False]

options.name: --type-flow
options.description: Bound each interface hop by the concrete types a member can obtain, not merely reach. Experimental; narrows selection at the cost of a second semantic pass. [default: False]

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: Directory holding the cached graph, relative to the repository root. Defaults to .tia.

options.name: --max-filter-length
options.description: Longest filter argument to emit before a project runs unfiltered. Defaults to the platform's command-line limit.

options.name: --coverage-threshold
options.description: Fraction of a project's tests above which it runs unfiltered rather than being filtered. Defaults to 0.6.

options.name: --fail-on-untested
options.description: Exit 1 when a changed symbol is reached by no test. Checks every changed symbol, however many. [default: False]

options.name: --annotations
options.description: Under GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines, annotate each untested change on the pull request's diff. Does nothing elsewhere. [default: False]

options.name: --codequality
options.description: Write the untested changes as a GitLab Code Quality report to this file, for the merge request widget.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Append a Markdown summary of the selection to this file, such as $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.

options.name: --shard
options.description: Run only part i of n of the selection, such as 2/4, for splitting it across CI jobs. Every shard must analyse the same commit with the same options.

options.name: --shard-durations
options.description: With --shard: balance shards by the test durations in this file (`run --record-durations` writes .tia/durations.json). Give every shard the same file.

options.name: --report-skipped
options.description: List the tests this selection leaves out, per project, in the JSON report, so a later failure of one can be recognised as a selection miss. [default: False]

options.name: --report-inventory
options.description: Also list every discovered test in the JSON report, so that `run --from-report` can --shard it. [default: False]

options.name: --report
options.description: Also write the JSON report to this file.

options.name: --no-server
options.description: Analyse in this process even when a `dotnet tia server` is running here. [default: False]

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build and test this configuration, such as Release. Unlike passing it after --, it keeps the build running alongside the analysis.

options.name: --results-directory
options.description: Keep TRX results here, in a folder per test project, for a test reporter or cifail. Asks each runner in its own way.

options.description: Fail when more than this many usable samples broke no test at all. Measures the suite rather than the selection, so it is off unless given.
